title: 2x Plug Plants Broad Bean Masterpiece Green Longpod Early High Yield
description:
Broad Bean ‘Masterpiece Green Longpod’ is an outstanding variety producing long, well-filled pods with fresh light green beans of superb flavour. Plants are vigorous and quick to mature, giving an early June crop from a spring sowing.



Pods: long, elegant, and generously filled



Flavour: best when picked young for tender beans; very young pods can be eaten whole



Growth: vigorous plants, reliable and early cropping



Height: approx. 90–100cm




Care:


Plant in rich, well-drained soil in a sunny position. Keep soil moist during flowering and pod set. Pinch out tips once the first pods have formed to help control blackfly and encourage bushier plants. Harvest from the base upwards when pods are well filled and beans still tender.
